name: Measured-away states, 1,074 qubits
description: The 1,072-qubit oracle with two more qubits. Intermediate hashes are measured away and their phases removed later, so the circuit holds one compression at a time. In the 34 rounds of the header's second block that have no scratch, the two extra qubits carry Gidney's constant adder: carries are measured as they are used, and the phases are removed by XORing the carries twice into borrowed busy qubits. A round constant there costs 89 Toffolis at most instead of 558 on average.
